findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be at 0ppm Quat. Discussed with PIC, the sanitizing line at triple sink dispenser was not working. Maintenance will service dispenser, PIC remade sanitizer bucket and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Inspector will follow up with facility on 9/14/2026. Ensure santizer solution is prepared and available at the proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed a container of sliced peppers to be held pat 7 day date marking limit. Discussed with PIC, item was pulled and discarded. Ensure any TCS food is discarded after 7 day date marking maximum. 

3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed the right cooler door gasket to be coming off. Discussed with PIC, a new gasket will be ordered. Ensure equipment is in good repair and is working to the manufacturer’s standards.  

4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

(REPEAT) Observed the interior fans of the reach-in cooler to have a layer of dust. Ensure routine cleaning of these fans. Discussed with PIC - wash, rinse, sanitize. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspections on 2/2/23 and 5/23/23.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed the following physical facility repairs in need:
1. Hand sink in the kitchen needs re-caulked - coming away from the wall and sink. Repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/2/23 and 5/23/23.
2. Several of the floor tiles are rusted and/or coming away in front of the walk-in cooler/freezer. Repair the flooring. Repeat since last routine inspection on 5/23/23.
3. Hot holding steam table (wooden; sealed with clear coat) is beginning to loose its clear coat sealant. Resurface and reseal the wooden table. Repeat since last routine inspection on 5/23/23.
4. There has been a new walk-in cooler and freezer installed. There is a gap to the left of the walk-in cooler between the floor and the cooler itself. Fill the gap so it is smooth and easily cleanable.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure the maintenance staff repairs the above. Correct by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

Observed no certified food protection manager (CFPM) present during the inspection. Ensure facility has at least one CFPM present during operational hours. Discussed with kitchen PIC. PIC is scheduled to take the CFPM class and exam at the end of June. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.13: (A) In manual WAREWASHING operations, a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and SANITIZING temperatures. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature. 

Observed no measuring device for temperatures regarding the heat at the dish machine. Facility needs a maximum registering thermometer and/or heat test strips in order to verify that the dish machine is heating to at least 160F. Discussed with PIC. Inspector will follow-up on 2/13/23.
